notes:
T636 (row shape: solo ladders, panels compose — ruling 34). BUILT AND VERIFIED. `src/managent/main.zig` gains a per-row `shape` field (solo | panel | null) plus `shape_reasons` (one "<model>: <why>" line per selection decision). Solo = cheapest-measured-cost ladder after constraints; panel = anchor + greedy marginal complementarity over the T637 complementarity record. shape==null is LEGACY (existing rows behave exactly as before, never retroactively labelled).

WHAT: (1) `shape` settable at registration (bundle meta `shape:` key, validated to solo|panel) and amendable via the new `managent shape <id> [solo|panel]` verb (no value = read-only); `assign` reads it to pick the path. (2) Solo: `soloPick` chooses the candidate with the lowest measured median token cost; cost comes from `tools/complementarity-record.json` per_lane.cost readings via `readMeasuredCosts` (median across readings), never a hand-typed price list; a missing reading is UNKNOWN and is never assumed cheap or expensive — unknown-cost candidates are recorded as 'not compared', and when NO candidate has a known cost the pick falls back to a uniform draw (method=random) and says so. (3) Panel: `buildCaughtSets` aggregates who-caught-what across every group of the complementarity record; `greedyPanelStep` anchors on highest coverage then adds the model with the most unique catches given the seats already filled, cost as tie-break among equal marginals; when the record has no measured expectation for any qualified candidate (or none at all) the pick is method=panel-prior and is labelled 'prior-driven … guessing (uniform draw)' loudly in shape_reasons. `--seats` supplies already-seated models so a second/third seat can be composed. (4) Both paths share T635's `filterQualified` (appetite/exclusion constraints) and the identical `candidates`/`method`/`reasons`/`model` record — `selectForShape` writes the same AssignResult whichever shape applied, and `requested` (--model) / single-candidate / no-candidate branches behave exactly as T635's assignModel.

DEFAULT (argued): new rows without an explicit shape default to SOLO. Solo fails more safely: if a genuinely panel-valued row is mis-labelled solo, the failure is one lane doing the work (a valid, if less diverse, result) and the shape is amendable before any real cost; if the default were panel, a solo (single-lane) row would get greedy-complementarity composition — needless extra lanes and cost for work where a second finder is duplication, not value. Cheapest-first is also the economical default for the majority of rows (implementation/bookkeeping/infra).

CONTROLS (all seeded, all green — `zig test src/managent/main.zig` 38/38; T636 tests are #12–20; wired into `zig build test` via the pre-existing managent_tests addTest step at build.zig:164): (1) solo with 3 known costs → cheapest chosen, the two passed over recorded with cost reasons; (2) solo with cheapest excluded by constraint → next cheapest chosen, pass-over recorded (exclusion reason is filterQualified's job, covered by T635's exclusion tests); (3) solo all-costs-unknown → random draw labelled 'measured cost unknown', never assumed; (4) panel B strict subset of A → disjoint C is the second seat, not B; (5) panel empty seats → anchor is highest coverage; (6) panel empty complementarity record → method=panel-prior, 'prior-driven' reason present; (7) panel greedy marginal over a seeded caught map picks the disjoint seat; (8) legacy row with no shape parses to null, no retroactive label; (9) shape + shape_reasons round-trip serialize→parse.

VERIFICATION — `zig build` green; per-module `zig test src/managent/main.zig` 38/38. End-to-end smoke against a scratch MANAGENT_STORE (never the live kanban): `shape T636` (null → 'legacy draw'), `shape T636 solo`, `assign --dry-run` (solo → cheapest measured cost = claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at 1403846 tokens, opus/sonnet passed over with token comparisons, deepseek lanes 'cost unknown'); `shape T636 panel`, `assign --dry-run` (panel → anchor claude-opus-5, 'adds 58 unique catch(es)'), `assign --dry-run --seats claude-opus-5,claude-sonnet-5` (panel-full error: no qualified candidate adds a unique catch — verified correct against the record: opus∪sonnet already cover all 59 union items). The implementation was already present in the working tree (committed 7644e4a) when this seat claimed the stalled row; invariants are asserted directly rather than re-deriving a red state, which would require reverting a completed implementation.

DESIGN DECISIONS / LIMITS: (a) cost is the median over the complementarity record's per_lane readings, not task-type-scoped (the row carries no task_type yet), so the ladder ranks on the whole-record central reading and says so; (b) caught sets are likewise aggregated across all groups — the honest whole-record prior, labelled a prior in panel selection reasons; (c) harness-fits-scope remains expressed through row exclusions (bundle `exclude=` / `--exclude`), the same mechanism T635 uses — no separate mechanized scope check was added (not in this row's brief); (d) `docs/infra/managent/spec.md` still does not list `assign`/`shape` — pre-existing drift from earlier verbs, not fixed here (not in this row's deliverables).
